decoded.meaning: An outer TLV whose type is the unassigned core-range code 0x1F, opaque body AA BB CC. A codec decodes it as an unknown core-range code and skips it by its declared length (reference/01 §Handling unknown type codes).
decoded.note: What a receiving node answers is not claimed here: a bare outer TLV carries no src, and only the retired 0x11-0x13 have a specific answer rule. See description.md.
